use strict;
use warnings;

=pod

Documentation block.

=cut

my %ages = (alice => 30, bob => 25);
my @names = qw(alice bob carol);
my $count = scalar(@names);

sub greet {
    my ($name, $times) = @_;
    my $text = "Hello, $name!\n";
    my $raw = 'single $not';
    (my $clean = $text) =~ s/\s+$//g;
    $clean =~ tr/a-z/A-Z/;
    return $clean x $times if $name =~ m{^[a-z]+$}i;
    return q{fallback} . qq[ for $name];
}

foreach my $n (sort keys %ages) {
    printf "%s is %d\n", $n, $ages{$n} unless $n eq 'bob';
}
my $re = qr/\d+/;
print <<"EOT";
Heredoc for $count names
EOT
print greet($names[0], 2), 0x1F + 1_000 + 3.14, "\x41";
